info.name: SAP Cloud ALM CDM Features API
info.description:
Postman collection for the SAP Cloud ALM CDM Features OData V4 API (calm-features/v1).

Covered operations:
- Reference data: FeatureStatus, FeaturePriorities
- List and filter Features with OData options ($filter, $select, $expand, $count)
- Create and update (PATCH) Features
- URL References and External References (create, list, delete)
- Task Assignments, Transports, Transport References (read-only)
- Sandbox mode (API key, no credentials required)

Before running:
1. Import this collection and the matching environment file.
2. Fill in ACCESS_TOKEN_URL, CLIENT_ID, CLIENT_SECRET, and PROJECT_UUID in the environment.
3. Set BASE_URL to the full resolved URL without a trailing slash,
   e.g. https://mytenant.eu10.alm.cloud.sap/api/calm-features/v1
4. For sandbox requests use the '6 - Sandbox (read-only, no credentials)' folder — set APIKEY instead.

Base URL (production): https://<tenant>.<region>.alm.cloud.sap/api/calm-features/v1  (no trailing slash)
Base URL (sandbox):    https://sandbox.api.sap.com/SAPCALM/calm-features/v1

exec: // Auto-fetch OAuth2 token before each request (skipped for sandbox folder).
// Requires environment variables: ACCESS_TOKEN_URL, CLIENT_ID, CLIENT_SECRET.
// Caches the token until 60 seconds before expiry to avoid fetching on every request.

console.warn('[CDM Features] Bearer token not fetched. Missing environment variables: ' + missing.join(', ') + '. Fill in these values in the environment to authenticate. Requests will return 401 without a token.');

item.name: 0 - Reference Data
item.description: Read-only reference lists for valid status and priority codes. Run these to discover allowed values for statusCode and priorityCode before creating or updating Features.

request.description: Returns valid Feature status codes and display labels. Use these values for the statusCode field in POST/PATCH requests.
Returns valid Feature priority codes and display labels. Use these values for the priorityCode field in POST/PATCH requests.

item.name: 1 - Read Features
item.description: OData V4 GET requests demonstrating $top, $orderby, $filter, $select, $expand, $count, and $skip. Run these first to explore your data and copy a Feature UUID into the FEATURE_UUID environment variable.

request.description: Returns the 5 most-recently-modified Features. Good starting point to verify connectivity and discover Feature UUIDs.
Demonstrates combining $filter (status + priority), $select (specific fields), and $expand (related entities) in one request. Adjust the filter values to match your data.
Returns up to 10 Features and includes @odata.count (total count) in the response. Increase $skip by 10 to page through results.

exec: throw new Error('[CDM Features] FEATURE_UUID is not set. Run one of the GET Features requests first, copy a uuid from the response, and save it as FEATURE_UUID in the environment. Alternatively, run POST Feature (section 2) which sets FEATURE_UUID automatically.');

request.description: Retrieves a single Feature by UUID with URL References and External References expanded inline. Set FEATURE_UUID in the environment first (or run POST Feature in section 2 which captures it automatically).

item.name: 2 - Create and Update
item.description: Create new Features (POST) and update existing ones (PATCH). The POST requests include test scripts that automatically capture the new Feature UUID into FEATURE_UUID — no manual copy-paste needed. Set PROJECT_UUID in the environment before running POST requests.

exec: console.log('[CDM Features] FEATURE_UUID set to: ' + body.uuid);

request.description: Creates a Feature with the minimum required fields. Set PROJECT_UUID in the environment before running. On success (201), FEATURE_UUID is automatically captured by the test script — no manual copy-paste needed.

exec: console.log('[CDM Features] FEATURE_UUID set to: ' + body.uuid);

request.description: Creates a Feature in one call with nested URL References and External References. Set PROJECT_UUID in the environment before running. On success (201), FEATURE_UUID is automatically captured. Replace jira:ABC-123 with your own reference IDs.
Updates statusCode and description on the Feature identified by FEATURE_UUID. Only the fields included in the body are changed — omitted fields are left unchanged.

item.name: 3 - URL References
item.description: Manage URL References attached to a Feature — hyperlinks to external documents such as specifications or design documents. Requires FEATURE_UUID. The POST request auto-captures URL_REF_UUID for the DELETE request.

request.description: Lists all URL References attached to the Feature identified by FEATURE_UUID.

exec: console.log('[CDM Features] URL_REF_UUID set to: ' + body.uuid);

request.description: Adds a URL Reference to the Feature identified by FEATURE_UUID. On success (201), URL_REF_UUID is automatically captured by the test script for use in the DELETE request.

Deletes the URL Reference identified by URL_REF_UUID. Operates on the standalone /URLReferences endpoint using the reference UUID as key. URL_REF_UUID is auto-set by the POST Feature URLReference test script.

item.name: 4 - External References
item.description: Manage External References — typed links to external systems such as Jira tickets or GitHub issues. Requires FEATURE_UUID. EXT_REF_ID is auto-captured (URL-encoded) after POST for the idempotency check and DELETE requests.

request.description: Lists all External References attached to the Feature identified by FEATURE_UUID.

Checks whether an External Reference with id 'jira:ABC-123' already exists on the Feature. Returns an empty value array if not found. Run this before POST ExternalReference to implement an idempotent upsert pattern — only POST if the result array is empty.

exec: console.log('[CDM Features] EXT_REF_ID set to: ' + encodeURIComponent(body.id));

request.description: Adds an External Reference to the Feature identified by FEATURE_UUID. On success (201), EXT_REF_ID is automatically captured (URL-encoded, colons → %3A) by the test script for use in the DELETE request.

Deletes the External Reference identified by EXT_REF_ID on the Feature identified by FEATURE_UUID. Uses a composite key path /ExternalReferences/{encoded-id}/{featureUuid}. EXT_REF_ID must be URL-encoded (colons → %3A) — auto-set by the POST Feature ExternalReference test script.

item.name: 5 - Related Entities (read-only)
item.description: Read-only navigation to entities linked to a Feature: Task Assignments, Transports, and Transport References. These are created by other SAP Cloud ALM modules; the Features API exposes them as read-only navigation properties.

request.description: Lists Task Assignments linked to the Feature identified by FEATURE_UUID. Task Assignments are created by other SAP Cloud ALM modules; read-only from the Features API.
Lists Transport objects linked to the Feature. Read-only navigation — transports are managed by the Change and Transport Management module.
Lists Transport References linked to the Feature. Read-only navigation to on-premise transport requests associated with this Feature.

item.name: 6 - Sandbox (read-only, no credentials)
item.description: Read-only requests against the SAP API Business Hub sandbox. No OAuth2 setup needed — set APIKEY in the environment to your free key from https://api.sap.com. The collection pre-request script is automatically skipped when OAuth2 credentials are absent.

request.description: Retrieves Feature status reference data from the SAP API Business Hub sandbox using the apikey header. No OAuth2 credentials needed.
Lists the first 3 Features from the sandbox. Sandbox data is read-only and shared across all API Business Hub users. Useful for exploring the response structure without a tenant setup.
